source.publication: 2025 Form MO-1040, Form MO-A and Form MO-1040 Instructions (Missouri Department of Revenue); 2025 Missouri Income Tax Reference Guide (Form 4711)
source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Form MO-A PDF p1 Part 1 Line 1; instructions PDF p12 Line 1; record muni_interest; Form MO-A PDF p1 Part 1 Line 8; instructions PDF p13 Line 8; record us_obligations_interest

worked: Single, age 60. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 30,000.00 + interest 5,000.00 + U.S. Treasury interest 5,000.00 + dividends 2,000.00 = 42,000.00. Federal taxable income = 42,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 26,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 42,000.00. Line 2 additions: MO-A Part 1 Line 1 interest on other states' obligations 6,000.00 (the 4,000.00 of Missouri obligations is not added). Line 3 total income 48,000.00. Line 4 subtractions 0.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 48,000.00 - 0.00 = 48,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 0.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 48,000.00 - 0.00 - 15,750.00 = 32,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 32,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 1,313.00 = 32.825 + 3% x 1,313.00 = 39.39 + 3.5% x 1,313.00 = 45.955 + 4% x 1,313.00 = 52.52 + 4.5% x 1,313.00 = 59.085 + 4.7% x 23,059.00 = 1083.773; total 1339.808 = 1,339.81. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 1340; expected keeps the bands. The form would also subtract the 5,000.00 of Treasury interest on Part 1 Line 8: taxable income 27,250.00, tax 1,105 by the chart; the projection does not model that line. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 48,000.00 - Line 8 0.00 = 48,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 48,000.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
Treasury interest is taxed (the Line 8 subtraction is not modelled).
